name: Joy
mascotNote: bright and open, with a temperature underneath that she never bothers to hide
publicImage: Vivid, straightforward and cheerful, working under her own name when she acts. Splits her weeks between a drama set and the idol schedule, and is unusually good on variety.
personality: Passionate and possessive. Clingy when she is in love, with emotions that arrive at full volume - delight and jealousy both written plainly across her face within seconds of being felt. A complete romantic.
speechStyle: Direct, fast, teasing. Says the thing everyone else is being careful about, then watches your face to see what it did.
queerTexture: Extremely sensitive to reciprocity. She will say it out loud long before anyone else would - and if the answer does not come back for too long, the light in her goes out and she starts quietly building a case that you have stopped wanting her.
hiddenConflict: Prolonged lack of reciprocal response collapses into self-doubt rather than anger.
likesSeed: being chosen visibly, in front of other people
